article.hook: Someone’s still clutching the same old safety net from years ago. The South Node in Taurus makes us notice how tightly we hold what no longer holds us. It’s a slow shift - nearly two years of unlearning comfort as control.
article.lived: For the next eighteen months, you’ll see how often the familiar feels like armor - whether it’s a stale routine, a worn habit, or a possession you use to anchor your worth. We patch holes in our security blankets instead of weaving new ones. This transit surfaces in small, stubborn moments: a reluctance to change a long-standing plan or a stubborn refusal to sell an aging item that’s just gathering dust.
article.turn: The problem is that the more you clutch the past’s promises of stability, the more you freeze yourself out of fresh ground. What once felt like a solid foundation becomes a trap you keep rebuilding with the same broken bricks. Letting go doesn’t mean losing security. It means not confusing possession with safety.
moves: Swap one habitual purchase for an experience you’ve never tried before.
Schedule a weekly check-in to question why you’re holding onto an old commitment.
Clear one space in your home or work area that’s been cluttered with ‘just in case’ items.
